statusDetail.evidence: 10/10 end-to-end checks passed under bun 1.3.10: bootstrap+key, waiting page, keyless 403 (page and event POST), fragment framed with helper injected, data-recommended treatment, SSE reload signal, click POST recorded to state/events, runtime confirmed bun, clean stop. Logic extracted to src/ops (shared by CLI and routes — the store moved fully behind the boundary); errors map to honest statuses (400/404/409/500, corrupt never an empty list). 5 service tests via app.request(), suite 33/33, tsc clean.

tasks.title: daemon lifecycle: bind-or-attach, logs, health
deliverables: bind success = you are the daemon, EADDRINUSE = attach
GET /health with instance id + version
detached spawn, rotated logs
acceptanceCriteria: liveness is the socket, never a pid file
an EPERM pid probe is never read as process death
a corrupt daemon record is distinguished from an absent one and reported

statusDetail.evidence: Bind-or-attach on Bun.serve: bind success = you are the daemon, second bind on the held port throws (the socket is the mutex, no pid file anywhere in the liveness path). GET /health carries instance id, version, AND the served root so an attach to the wrong repo's daemon is detectable. Advisory daemon.json: absent → null, corrupt or wrong-shaped → StoreCorruptError, never read as empty. processAlive treats EPERM as alive (QK-RUN-012 class, tested with fake kill). Startup log rotation (1MB cap, keep 2). Hidden 'quirks serve' verb. 11 daemon tests; suite 44/44; tsc clean.

tasks.title: auth: the 0600 token credential

acceptanceCriteria: a request without the token is refused
tasks.risk: deferred by owner 2026-07-27 — loopback-only bind carries the interim; revisit before anything but localhost can reach the daemon

tasks.title: the CLI becomes an HTTP client with autostart
deliverables: CLI verbs call the routes; unreachable service reported as unreachable
acceptanceCriteria: no direct-store fallback exists anywhere in the CLI
kill the daemon mid-verb: the error names the service, never silently reopens the store

statusDetail.evidence: Every CLI verb now rides HTTP: src/cli/client.ts does bind-or-attach from the client side (probe /health; on silence spawn a detached 'quirks serve' and poll; verify the answering daemon serves THIS root — a foreign daemon is refused loudly, tested with an impostor server). No direct-store fallback: src/cli imports nothing from src/store or src/ops, enforced by a structural test that greps the sources. Corrupt store arrives as a 500 through the wire and still prints the corrupt teaching. Live-verified in this repo: goal list autostarted the daemon (port 47301) and read the rollup over the socket. Suite 46/46, tsc clean.

tasks.title: spike: transpiled TS core + terminal_sessions
deliverables: prove a transpiled TS core renders a LIVE shell in <terminal> (terminal_sessions=true), not the stub
first wire types + widget-node measurement
acceptanceCriteria: a real shell echoes in a TS-core app
widget_nodes reported against the 1024 budget
tasks.risk: the changelog is ambiguous on transpiled cores getting the real emulator — verify before building on it

statusDetail.evidence: SPIKE VERDICT: a transpiled TS core CANNOT drive a live <terminal> on SDK 0.6.1 — the gap is one inch wide and upstream-fixable. PROVEN WORKING: (1) TS pty command family exists and passes the subset checker (Cmd.ptySpawn/Write/Resize/Kill, shipped 0.6.0); (2) native eject + terminal_sessions=true on a TS-core app BUILDS — ghostty resolves and terminal_vt_ghostty links into the binary; (3) the app boots and answers automation. BLOCKED AT: <terminal pty> requires a bare {binding} resolving to an INTEGER u64 engine key; (a) transpiled model numbers surface as floats and the contract excludes integer arms (ui_markup_contract.zig), (b) the engine key for TS sessions is internal — pty_key_base 0x5453_5054_0000_0000 + table index, interned in ts_core_host.zig, no public accessor, (c) computed bindings like round() are refused (bare binding only). Three runtime teachings captured verbatim in the session. Fix belongs upstream: match TS string pty keys at the element, or expose the engine key to the TS tier. Widget-node measurement not meaningful (view never built). Spike code in scratchpad quirks-workbench-spike/.
